checkpoint.atomic_write: Under OS advisory exclusive lock: append full next-state event(seq,prev_hash,state_digest,state_payload), fsync events.jsonl; write state temp in same directory, fsync, rename state.json, fsync parent. No external action until durable launch-intent event and matching snapshot.
checkpoint.stale_run_policy: 先按lock_acquisition有界获取；活着的持锁者挂起时exit75并报告owner_unresponsive，不无限等待或自动杀进程。拿锁后才能检查/终止已验证本run孤儿组；不明/foreign进程阻断。
checkpoint.resume: validate plan/hash/head/foreign status; inspect commit history and evidence before repeating actions
checkpoint.blocked_resume: New trusted condition revision only; return to COMMITTING when any commit outcome/vector incomplete, otherwise READY after budget/permission checks. Expired task/wave deadline => NO_GO; new authorization alone does not reset attempts or deadlines.
checkpoint.single_writer_enforcement: 本地同host OS advisory exclusive lock + revision/owner CAS；按lock_acquisition采用LOCK_NB最多2秒。lease过期不能越过仍活着的持锁者；锁忙用独立不可变观察回执报告，不成为第二state/event writer。
checkpoint.recovery_order: Acquire OS lock; validate event hash chain and state revision/digest. Durable events ahead of snapshot replay their full state; snapshot ahead or contradictory => CONTRACT_CONFLICT. Incomplete final event tail copied to recovery evidence then truncated to last verified boundary under lock; interior corruption blocks. Never reuse revision or decrement attempt.
checkpoint.commit_unknown: Remain COMMITTING with outcome=COMMIT_UNKNOWN or BLOCKED_EXTERNAL/resume_state=COMMITTING. Read exact parent/tree/trailers/path set for each repository; matched commit only recorded, never repeated. Definitely absent commit may run only once after reverify; conflicting/ambiguous history => CONTRACT_CONFLICT. Partial vector cannot PASS.
checkpoint.candidate_invalidation: PASS record immutable for exact input digest. Planned successor edits require current-task supplementary regression under candidate_progression_contract; old receipt historical only. Actual reopening of old implementation task preserves its attempts/repair/deadline, no run-id reset. Commit-only tested tree equivalence may rebind after exact digest verification; ambiguous/external drift CONTRACT_CONFLICT.

lock_acquisition.api: OS advisory exclusive LOCK_NB, retry at most within2 seconds total; never blocking flock
lock_acquisition.busy_result: Return exit75/BLOCKED_EXTERNAL with reason=writer_lock_busy within2s; write immutable per-invocation observation <run_dir>/observations/<unique_invocation_id>.json via O_EXCL+fsync, stdout same receipt. Do not modify state.json/events.jsonl without writer lock, do not consume launch attempt or claim new task. Observation is not authoritative task state/PASS.
lock_acquisition.frozen_holder: If owner PID/start identity exists but heartbeat/lease expired, report owner_unresponsive and stop. No auto-kill of live writer, no takeover, no polling loop. Trusted explicit recovery may stop verified owned group using existing10s+5s protocol, then reacquire; ambiguous identity remains blocked.
lock_acquisition.dead_holder: After OS lock released on process exit, inspect and stop owned orphan groups before replay; stale metadata does not grant access while OS lock held.
lock_acquisition.watch_scope: A hung old process cannot truthfully update its own task state; external invocation supplies bounded obstruction receipt. No autonomous guaranteed successful recovery of live hung OS holder is claimed; safe finite refusal is required.

checkpoint.parallel_tasks: Parallel W5 task_records keyed by task_id with independent state/attempt/launch/owned files; central writer only; worker receipt input digest checked before merge. Commit queue serialized.

retry_policy.budget_scope: durable logical task across runner restarts/run-id changes; run-id is not permission to reset counts; replacement budget requires reviewed contract and trusted explicit authorization
retry_policy.safety_failure_classification: Independent Reviewer distinguishes implementation defect fixable within frozen scope (<=2 repair rounds) from design conflict requiring new plan/authorization. Never change oracle/required set to pass.

timeouts.on_timeout: Persist timeout and stop owned process group: TERM grace 10s then KILL, wait at most 5s and verify descendants gone. No kill of foreign or ambiguous PID; failed containment => BLOCKED_EXTERNAL. Consume durable attempt even before child produces output.
timeouts.persistent_deadlines: 任务默认8h，W1-02 16h，W6-01 48h，W6-02 12h；wave默认24h、W6 96h；run7天。命令≤1800s。首次启动持久deadline，含重试/等待/阻断，重启和候选变化不重计；W5各任务独立计时。
timeouts.clock: Use monotonic elapsed within boot and persisted UTC deadlines across restart; rollback/clock anomaly => BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, no budget reset.
timeouts.outcome: External unavailable within budget => BLOCKED_EXTERNAL; exhausted attempts/deadline => NO_GO; verifying timeout has legal blocked transition; committing timeout records unknown and reconciles before any retry.

upload_content_contract.pin: 网关完整读入run-owned/服务私有临时文件，限制现有大小和读取超时，服务端计算实际上传字节SHA256（E2EE为密文）；按原声明检查，再取父/I/session锁，NULL→完整receipt一次CAS并提交。已有receipt只允许完全相等；不同字节/size/mime409且provider PUT调用0。未知COMMIT只读调和，同receipt已提交才可继续；无durable pin不得外部写。
upload_content_contract.immutability: M2 pin函数不接受任意清零/替换；M3禁止runtime直接INSERT/UPDATE伪造或清空receipt。受限网关调用仍必须从自己读取的受控字节计算，不能直接相信请求提供的hash。遗留普通writer在适配完成前不得操作新V5会话。
upload_content_contract.retries: 相同key只允许完全相同上传字节；网络结果未知、旧worker延迟、多并发请求均最多写同一hash/size/mime。已confirmed的新请求只允许stat回读同receipt或明确already_confirmed，不发起新的PUT。已在途的同receipt PUT即使晚于confirm结束也不能改变逻辑字节。
upload_content_contract.temp_file: 私有0600独占创建，校验后关闭写FD并持只读FD/同一不可替换文件，HTTP发送同一校验内容；不得先hash路径A再重新打开可被替换的路径；失败清理仅本请求临时文件，不能删对象作为补偿。
upload_content_contract.confirm: 取精确I真实对象流并计算SHA256/size，必须等于durable upload_content及适用原声明；HEAD/ETag/HTTP200单独不足。随后同锁重查session/receipt/位置版本，合法才COMMIT confirmed。真实GET不存在/不符/未知不得确认。响应丢失只读原confirmed结果；不重复注册/计引用。
upload_content_contract.legacy: 没有receipt或仍有历史直传能力的对象不套用字节不可变证明；保留旧读ACL和gc_verified=false，恢复/确认需证明所有旧写能力耗尽后验证并专用proof补值，做不到就返回稳定重传要求。绝不从当前HEAD返回值直接补成可信receipt。

upload_write_boundary.decision: V5所有新会话的客户端写能力只指向IMBoy受控入口，不把可任意覆写的Garage presigned PUT URL交给客户端。普通/internal复用原计划中的attachment_storage_gateway_handler并保留put_url/object_key/expires_at字段与裸PUT；EB/widget复用已有字节代理，multipart复用现有attach_handler。无新上传SDK/队列/表。
upload_write_boundary.phase: W2-01先实现已有Garage路径的最小gateway+pin协议，复用elib_oss带显式bucket的IO；W2-02真实确认hash及幂等；W4-03把这些路径迁入统一Storage Boundary并补Disk，不能让W2测试前向依赖W4 gateway。 W2-01必须同时修改eb_asset_object_garage:put/3，把冻结Context从eb_asset_store传入elib_oss新显式Context入口，再传elib_s3_sign；四参数旧接口保留给非V5 writer，新V5路径禁用该相对TTL接口。
upload_write_boundary.capability: 普通/internal采用现有签名组件的专用upload audience、操作、session/key、原主体摘要、固定expires及key-version；与登录JWT分离验证，token不是读/confirm授权。裸PUT兼容，无JWT/Cookie，跨域预检/CORS按既有客户端验证。EB/widget保留upload_ref外形与原鉴权。全部能力仅内存，重启重新status/renew。
upload_write_boundary.garage: 网关向Garage写入只发送已pin的确切字节，内部签名URL不返回客户端。其绝对到期不得晚于已持久upload_expires_at；签名器显式接收冻结issued_at/expires_at，不在暂停恢复后用当前时间重新延长TTL。发起前DB复验，未知停止。过期能力在真实Garage必须拒绝；已在途请求仍按既有drain证明处理，不能从HTTP客户端30秒超时推出远端必停；无法证明则该类GC继续blocked。
upload_write_boundary.disk: 同完整I的PUT与DELETE在私有root侧共享稳定OS文件锁，非阻塞/5秒限时；锁文件不在对象删除时unlink，不以租约强行接管活进程。拿锁后重新查session/intent/receipt/expiry；DB事务全部结束后才文件IO，任何路径不得持DB锁等待OS锁。PUT写私有temp后原子发布，DELETE同锁验证已提交job再unlink，已暂停PUT持锁期间DELETE不得越过，因此旧PUT不能在DELETE后重建对象。不能取得锁则有限retry/blocked，不宣称物理完成。 OS锁等待计入driver30秒总预算，不额外延长Worker45秒服务上界。
upload_write_boundary.other_writers: 扫描并适配所有elib_oss/EB object store/server-side multipart写入口；V5 key不可绕过pin。管理员存储凭据/外部S3写入不属于runtime模型，部署必须保证客户端没有这种凭据；发现旁路writer则G4失败。
upload_write_boundary.tradeoff: 普通Garage上传增加一次后端转发及Confirm完整对象读校验；W2/W4测最大支持文件、临时磁盘/并发/内存/超时与旧客户端progress/CORS，无法满足既有限额则阻断Gate，不能退回不受控直传。保留当前server文件PUT读取refc binary的限制，不顺便重写HTTP栈。
upload_write_boundary.source_support: Garage官方兼容表只作为设计参考，不作为实例验收；未依赖其对象版本或条件写，版本/运行能力仍由run-owned真实测试记录。
